stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Auditarch can take 1 legendary action per combat, choosing from the options below:

additionalAbilities.name: Commanding Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Allies within 30 feet of the Auditarch gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while they can see or hear her. Additionally, allied creatures recover 1d8 hit points whenever the Auditarch uses her legendary action to inspire.

additionalAbilities.name: Audit Authority
additionalAbilities.description: The Auditarch can issue tactical orders to bolster her underlings. As a bonus action, she can grant up to two allies within 30 feet a +2 bonus to attack rolls or AC until the end of her next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: The dark dimension auditarch is a 7th-level spellcaster. The dark dimension auditarch's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The dark dimension auditarch has the following bard spells prepared: Cantrip (at will): blade ward, mage hand, minor illusion 1st level (4 slots): healing word 2nd level (3 slots): heroism 3rd level (3 slots): mass healing word 4th level (1 slots): greater invisibility

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Auditarch makes two attacks with her **Empowered Saber** and casts one spell.

actions.name: Empowered Saber
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Arcane Volley
actions.description: The Auditarch fires a barrage of magical energy at up to three targets within 30 ft. Each target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Inspired Command
legendaryActions.description: She grants up to three allies within 30 feet a +2 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of their next turn. Allies affected also regain 1d8 hit points.

legendaryActions.name: Disruptive Audit
legendaryActions.description: The Auditarch issues a magically charged reprimand to one enemy within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

flavor.description: The Shadow Slimepress is an arrogant and tyrannical monarch of the deep. This massive ooze rules over a grotesque court of ooze-kin with an oppressive, corrosive presence. Its shifting form and psychic decrees subdue all who defy its orders.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The shadow slimepress can take 1legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The shadow slimepress regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn unless otherwise noted.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The Slimepress can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Corrosive Form
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Slimepress or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Imperious Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature hostile to the Slimepress that starts its turn within 30 feet of her must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, it is immune to this aura for 24 hours. Creatures allied with the Slimepress are immune to being frightened and gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Slimepress can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Slimepress makes two Pseudopod Lash attacks or one Pseudopod Lash attack and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Pseudopod Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone or pushed up to 10 feet away (Slimepress's choice).

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The Slimepress moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. When entering a creature's space, that creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the creature chooses to be pushed 5 feet away. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. An engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Slimepress's turns. When the Slimepress moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can escape by taking an action to succeed on a DC 15 Strength check. The Slimepress can engulf up to two Medium creatures or one Large creature at a time.

actions.name: Demanding Decree (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Slimepress issues a psychic command to all creatures of her choice within 60 feet that she is aware of. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage and be compelled to obey a single, one-word command (e.g., 'Grovel', 'Flee', 'Halt', 'Betray'). The compelled creature uses its next turn to obey as best as it can. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not compelled.

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
legendaryActions.description: If the Slimepress fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

flavor.description: A towering evolution of the Darkling‑Ossuite Charger, she embodies both savage brutality and an almost otherworldly allure—her presence on the battlefield is as mesmerizing as it is deadly.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Darkling‑Ossuite Charger Omega, Shadowstorm Incarnate can take one legendary action per round from the following options:

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactician (Elite Coordination)
additionalAbilities.description: When in groups of more than 2, allied dark creatures work in concert. The Charger Omega can use her reaction to issue silent telepathic orders to any allied darkling within 150 ft—if they follow her command, they gain advantage on their next action.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Resurgence
additionalAbilities.description: If unscathed for 1 round, the Charger Omega begins to regenerate her shadowy essence. At the end of each round she remains unwounded (and hasn’t moved more than 15 ft), she regains 2d8 hit points.

additionalAbilities.name: Lucky Feat
additionalAbilities.description: Shadowstorm may reroll up to three failed attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws per encounter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Shadowstorm makes two melee attacks, either two Lance Strikes or one Lance Strike and one Hoof Stomp.

actions.name: Lance of Dusk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Piercing): +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 1d8 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hoof Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Bludgeoning): +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Charging Trample
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Bludgeoning): +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the Charger Omega moved at least 20 ft in a straight line immediately before this attack, the target is also knocked prone and takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadowy Tendrils (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Charger Omega lashes out with writhing tendrils in a 15-ft cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 3d8 necrotic damage and be slowed (reducing its speed by 10 ft.) until the end of her next turn.

reactions.name: Back Kick
reactions.description: When an enemy passes through any threatened square within reach of the Charger Omega, it may make one hoof stomp attack.

legendaryActions.name: Tendril Ballista (Ultimate Attack, Once per Encounter)
legendaryActions.description: The Charger Omega draws on the dark tendrils that lash from her lance to form a spectral arrow. Once per encounter, she fires it in a straight line up to 60 ft. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 7d10 necrotic damage and become entangled (their movement is halved) until the end of their next turn. A successful save halves the damage and leaves the creature unentangled.

legendaryActions.name: Miasma Veil
legendaryActions.description: The Charger Omega exhales a swirling shroud of black miasma in a 20-ft radius. Each creature within this area must make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 necrotic damage and becomes distracted (it has disadvantage on attack rolls) until the start of the Omega’s next turn; on a success, a creature takes half damage.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Lakeopus Rex can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The Lakeopus Rex regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Lakeopus Rex can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Aquatic Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Lakeopus Rex has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Grasping Tentacles
additionalAbilities.description: The Lakeopus Rex can have up to four creatures grappled at a time. It can use its tentacles to interact with an object or wield a weapon as if it had free hands.

additionalAbilities.name: Brack Armor
additionalAbilities.description: Unlike many darkformes, the Lakeopus Rex does not have a typical weakness to radiant damage. However, whenever it is at less than half hit dice total HP, the Radiant Weakness becomes active.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Lakeopus Rex makes three attacks: one with its Crushing Bite and two with its Tentacles.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the Lakeopus Rex cannot use the same tentacle to attack another target.

actions.name: Ink Cloud (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A 30-foot-radius cloud of inky blackness extends out from the Lakeopus Rex in the water. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. A creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The Lakeopus Rex makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Lakeopus Rex makes one Tentacle attack.

legendaryActions.name: Constricting Crush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature grappled by the Lakeopus Rex must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, taking 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
legendaryActions.description: If the Lakeopus Rex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

damageImmunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks not made with Adamantine weapons
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

additionalAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
additionalAbilities.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pacifying Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The golem emits a wave of calming energy in a 30-foot radius. While affected, a creature cannot speak competently and has a 75% chance to fail any spell with a verbal component.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Abyssal Leviathan can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Abyssal Leviathan regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Abyssal Leviathan can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Abyssal Leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: The Abyssal Leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Abyssal Aura
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of the Abyssal Leviathan's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) cold damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature that touches the Abyssal Leviathan or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes this damage as well. Additionally, the area within 30 feet of the Leviathan is difficult terrain for creatures other than darklings.

additionalAbilities.name: Deep Dweller
additionalAbilities.description: The Abyssal Leviathan has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in deep or murky water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Tentacle Slams.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10+8) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Abyssal Leviathan can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8+8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the Abyssal Leviathan's choice that is within 120 feet of the Abyssal Leviathan and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Abyssal Leviathan's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan makes one bite attack against a Huge or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Abyssal Leviathan, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Abyssal Leviathan's turns. If the Abyssal Leviathan takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Abyssal Leviathan must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the Abyssal Leviathan. If the Abyssal Leviathan dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan makes one Tentacle Slam attack.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Depths (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan intensifies its abyssal aura. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet directly towards the Leviathan and be knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Pathetic Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that targets the plushie with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. actions.name: Sad Cuddle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the plushie for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature is unwilling to move away from the plushie.

additionalAbilities.name: Dimensional Seal (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: As an action, the Planar Warden can attempt to temporarily seal a minor dimensional seam or temporal flux zone within 30 feet. This requires a successful DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana) check. If successful, the anomaly is suppressed for 1d4 hours.

actions.name: Stabilizing Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage. If the target is a creature that originated from another plane, it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Echo Inquisitor can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Echo Inquisitor regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Paradox
additionalAbilities.description: When the Echo Inquisitor hits a creature with an attack, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by a temporal paradox. On a failed save, the target takes an extra 3d6 psychic damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn as its movements are briefly out of sync with time.

additionalAbilities.name: Planar Shift (Recharge 5-6)
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Echo Inquisitor can teleport up to 60 feet. After teleporting, it can choose one creature within 10 feet of its destination. That creature must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be banished to a random demiplane for 1 round, returning to its original space (or the nearest unoccupied space) at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Echo Inquisitor makes two Temporal Lash attacks.

actions.name: Temporal Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage.

legendaryActions.name: Flicker (1 Action)
legendaryActions.description: The Echo Inquisitor uses Temporal Paradox.

legendaryActions.name: Echo Gaze (2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Echo Inquisitor targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Reality Warp (3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Echo Inquisitor causes the ground in a 10-foot radius within 60 feet to become difficult terrain until the start of its next turn, as reality briefly twists.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Mire-Croaker can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Standing Leap
additionalAbilities.description: The Mire-Croaker's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

additionalAbilities.name: Swamp Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Mire-Croaker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 15 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the Mire-Croaker. If the target ends this movement within 5 feet of the Mire-Croaker, the Mire-Croaker can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Dismal Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Mire-Croaker unleashes a horrifyingly deep and resonant croak. Each creature within 30 feet of the Mire-Croaker that can hear it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Pond-Skulker can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Bait Snatcher
additionalAbilities.description: The Pond-Skulker has advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to steal small, unattended objects or items from a fishing line.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadowy Escape
additionalAbilities.description: If in dim light or darkness, the Pond-Skulker can use a bonus action to Hide after a successful Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check or if it misses with an attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Annoying Splash
actions.description: The Pond-Skulker splashes water at a creature within 10 feet of it that is on land. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While motionless, the rattle is indistinguishable from a normal toy.

actions.name: Bonk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dazing Rattle (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The rattle shakes violently, creating a disorienting sound in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the end of its next turn. While dazed, a creature can't take reactions and can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

additionalAbilities.name: Cunning Action
additionalAbilities.description: On each of its turns, the Ticklefinger can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tickle
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be overcome with magical laughter, falling prone and becoming incapacitated for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The River-Lurk can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Slippery
additionalAbilities.description: The River-Lurk has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

additionalAbilities.name: Waterside Skulk
additionalAbilities.description: The River-Lurk has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when it is within 5 feet of a body of water.

actions.name: Constricting Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, and if the target is a Small or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the River-Lurk can't constrict another target.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Weed-Tangler can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the Weed-Tangler remains motionless in water with sufficient plant life, it is indistinguishable from normal aquatic weeds.

additionalAbilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
additionalAbilities.description: The Weed-Tangler can have up to two creatures grappled at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Weed-Tangler makes two tendril attacks.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Drag Under
actions.description: The Weed-Tangler attempts to pull one creature grappled by it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 feet towards the Weed-Tangler and, if in water, 5 feet under the surface.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Stealth
additionalAbilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the babysitter can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The babysitter makes two Shadow Lash attacks.

actions.name: Shadow Lash
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the babysitter until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Chains of Shadow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The babysitter targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by shadowy chains for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength check to break the chains.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description: The babysitter targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet. If the target can see the babysitter, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 hour. The charmed target regards the babysitter as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Current-Snapper can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Iron Jaws
additionalAbilities.description: If the Current-Snapper hits a creature with its Bite attack, the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Current-Snapper can't bite another target.

additionalAbilities.name: Sudden Lunge
additionalAbilities.description: If the Current-Snapper moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Maid's Judgment
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the maid can target one creature she can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or the maid learns if the creature has disobeyed a rule or command in the last hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The maid makes two attacks with her Paddle of Penance.

actions.name: Paddle of Penance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the maid's next turn.

actions.name: Time-Out (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The maid targets one creature she can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be magically paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Mud-Gnasher can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Mud Lurker
additionalAbilities.description: The Mud-Gnasher can use a bonus action to Hide when it is at least lightly obscured by mud or murky water.

additionalAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
additionalAbilities.description: If the Mud-Gnasher surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Muddy Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Mud-Gnasher erupts from the mud or murky water in a 10-foot radius around it. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
additionalAbilities.description: The onesie is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the onesie must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the onesie remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal piece of clothing.

actions.name: Smother
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating, and the onesie can't smother another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Swarm Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Murkfin Swarmer has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the swarmer's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Breathing
additionalAbilities.description: The Murkfin Swarmer can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Razor Fin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) slashing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Angler-Lurk can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: False Lure
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Angler-Lurk can create a faint, captivating light or a subtle, enticing ripple on the water's surface within 5 feet of itself. A creature that can see the lure must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the Angler-Lurk until the start of its next turn. While charmed in this way, the creature is incapacitated and must use its movement to move towards the lure by the safest available route.

additionalAbilities.name: Murky Concealment
additionalAbilities.description: The Angler-Lurk has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in murky water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10+1) piercing damage. If the target is charmed by the Angler-Lurk, the attack is a critical hit.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the crib remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal crib.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The crib makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Enclose (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The crib targets one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the crib's space and become trapped. A trapped creature is restrained and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the crib. A creature can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check to escape.

actions.name: Rock to Sleep
actions.description: The crib gently rocks any creature trapped within it. The trapped creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes, or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The fog can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Mind-Clouding Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn inside the fog must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the Babybrain spell for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The fog moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter a creature's space. The creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet to the side. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, is engulfed, and is subjected to the Mind-Clouding Aura. The engulfed creature is restrained and can't breathe. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it escapes.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Murk Dweller
additionalAbilities.description: While submerged in murky water, the Titan-Snapper can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Unstoppable
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper has advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone, pushed, or grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Titan-Snapper makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Crushing Tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10+6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Titan-Snapper can't bite another target.

actions.name: Crushing Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The Titan-Snapper makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Titan-Snapper, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Titan-Snapper's turns. If the Titan-Snapper takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Titan-Snapper must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the Titan-Snapper. If the Titan-Snapper dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Dreadful Bellow (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Titan-Snapper emits a terrifying roar. Each creature of its choice within 60 feet of it that can hear it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Endurance
legendaryActions.description: If the Titan-Snapper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The rift can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The rift regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Planar Instability
additionalAbilities.description: The rift cannot be attacked or harmed by conventional means. Spells like dispel magic or remove curse cast at 6th level or higher can damage it. Closing the rift requires succeeding on three DC 18 Intelligence (Arcana) checks as an action while within 5 feet of it. Each failed check deals 11 (2d10) psychic damage to the checker.

additionalAbilities.name: Summoning Sickness
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of its turns, the rift summons 1d4 Darkling monsters or 1 Diaper-themed construct. Roll a d6: 1-2 (Darkling-Lurkers), 3-4 (Deranged Diaper-Check Bots), 5 (Darkforme Overwatch), 6 (Pacifier Golem). Summoned creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the rift and act on their own initiative.

actions.name: Planar Energy
actions.description: The rift hums with otherworldly energy but takes no direct action.

legendaryActions.name: Unravel Reality
legendaryActions.description: The rift targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and suffer a random effect from the Wild Magic Tantrum table.

legendaryActions.name: Dimensional Reach
legendaryActions.description: The rift attempts to pull one creature it can see within 120 feet into its dimension. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be pulled into a harmless demiplane. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Chaotic Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The rift releases a wave of energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the rift must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be affected by the Big Babification spell for 1 minute.

additionalAbilities.name: Aquatic Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Pike-Maw has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Breathing
additionalAbilities.description: The Pike-Maw can breathe only underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Darting Attack
additionalAbilities.description: If the Pike-Maw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 feet toward the Pike-Maw.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The field can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The field regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Anchor
additionalAbilities.description: The field is immune to effects that would move it or alter time within its space.

additionalAbilities.name: Regression Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the field must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by a magical regression. The creature's age is reduced by 1d4 x 2 years for 1 hour. If this reduces a creature's age below its age of maturity, it is affected as if by the Babybrain spell for the duration. The effect can be ended by remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Energy Pulse
actions.description: The field emits a low hum but takes no direct action.

legendaryActions.name: Focused Regression
legendaryActions.description: The field targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must repeat the saving throw against the Regression Aura.

legendaryActions.name: Mental Assault
legendaryActions.description: The field targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Drain Vitality (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the field must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The field regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Gloom-Newt can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Slippery Hide
additionalAbilities.description: The Gloom-Newt has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

additionalAbilities.name: Disorienting Slime
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Gloom-Newt or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Blood-Gorger can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Blood-Gorger can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Stealth
additionalAbilities.description: While in water, the Blood-Gorger has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

actions.name: Drain Blood
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, and the Blood-Gorger attaches to the target. While attached, the Blood-Gorger doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the Blood-Gorger's turns, the target loses 5 (1d6 + 2) hit points due to blood loss, and the Blood-Gorger regains hit points equal to the amount of hit points the target lost. The Blood-Gorger can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the Blood-Gorger with a successful DC 11 Strength check.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkling Rill-Skitter can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Murky Ambush
additionalAbilities.description: If the Darkling Rill-Skitter is in murky water or otherwise lightly obscured, it can use a bonus action to Hide. It has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

actions.name: Nipping Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
additionalAbilities.description: The lullaby can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of Dread
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lullaby must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Draining Melody
actions.description: The lullaby hums a dissonant tune. Each creature of the lullaby's choice within 60 feet that can hear it must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failure, a creature is also overcome with sorrow and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Sleep of Terrors (1/Day)
actions.description: The lullaby sings a haunting song. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. An unconscious creature is plagued by nightmares and takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The effect ends for a creature if it takes any damage from another source or if someone uses an action to shake it awake.

additionalAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Each creature of the abomination's choice that is within 120 feet of the abomination and aware of it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Spill Stuffing
additionalAbilities.description: When the abomination takes 15 or more slashing or piercing damage from a single attack, its stuffing spills out, creating an area of difficult terrain in a 10-foot radius around it that lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abomination makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Current-Drifter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Shocking Aura
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Current-Drifter or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Constricting Shock
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Current-Drifter emits a pulse of electrical energy. Each creature within 15 feet of it in the water must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The crying starmass can take 0 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The crying starmass regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.description: If the Bratnapper successfully grapples a creature, it can use its bonus action to attempt to “Bratnap” the target. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained as the Bratnapper wraps its dark energy restraints around them.

additionalAbilities.name: Babysitter

It shuffles slowly along the floor, exuding a pants‐crapping fear presence. Its hideous body carries brutal melee attacks reminiscent of lesser ossuite kin, and it wields an array of dark, divine spells that combine arcane and clerical power. Once per day, it can teleport to a new space, forcing all in its wake to contend with a crushing, pinning avalanche of bones.

• 1st level (4 slots): Inflict Wounds, Guiding Bolt
• 2nd level (3 slots): Spiritual Weapon, Hold Person, Blindness/Deafness
• 3rd level (2 slots): Animate Dead, Blight, Bestow Curse

Then, they must immediately roll a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw at disadvantage; on a failure, the creature becomes frightened for 1 minute (it can repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn to end the effect).

actions.name: Siphoning Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) acid damage.

flavor.description: Huge abomination—a living ossuary formed by countless ossuite remains fused into a massive, lumbering bone monster. It shuffles slowly along the floor, exuding a pants‐crapping fear presence. Its hideous body carries brutal melee attacks reminiscent of lesser ossuite kin, and it wields an array of dark, divine spells that combine arcane and clerical power. Once per day, it can teleport to a new space, forcing all in its wake to contend with a crushing, pinning avalanche of bones.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Darkforme-Ossuarian may take one legendary action per round from the options listed below.

additionalAbilities.name: Pants-Crapping Fear Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature within 30 ft. that can see the Darkforme-Ossuarian must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute—along with hypermessing or hyperwetting their smallclothes.

additionalAbilities.name: Living Ossuary Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description:
The Darkforme-Ossuarian is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spells). It has the following spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): Toll the Dead, Spare the Dying
• 1st level (4 slots): Inflict Wounds, Guiding Bolt
• 2nd level (3 slots): Spiritual Weapon, Hold Person, Blindness/Deafness
• 3rd level (2 slots): Animate Dead, Blight, Bestow Curse
• 4th level (1 slot): Banishment, Phantasmal Killer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Darkforme-Ossuarian makes two Bone Slam attacks and one Bone Rake attack.

actions.name: Bone Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+6 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bone Rake
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, the target suffers 1d8+6 slashing damage and, if grappled, becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Rebound Crush
reactions.description: When a creature successfully escapes its pinning effect, the Darkforme-Ossuarian may immediately make a Bone Slam attack against that creature.

legendaryActions.name: Bone Crush Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Once per day, the Darkforme-Ossuarian can teleport to any space it can see. Any creature occupying that space must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d12 crushing damage and become pinned. A pinned creature can attempt to break free at the end of each of its turns by succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) or Escape Artist check (DC 16).

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Stalker
additionalAbilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the Darkling Shade-Sneak has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkling Shade-Sneak has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Distracting Wail
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkling Bellowbelly’s torso-mounted mouth produces an eerie, discordant wail that affects all creatures within 30 ft. As a reaction on another creature's turn, the Bellowbelly may emit this sound. Any creature within range that can hear the wail must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Darkling Bellowbelly makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

flavor.description: A larger, more fearsome evolution of the Darkling-Ossuite Charger, this massive centauroid abomination uses its lance to deadly effect. It charges in a devastating line attack, trampling through foes, and can unleash shadowy tendrils to entangle and slow its enemies. Writhing black miasma flows over its skeletal, shadowy frame, forming a grotesque yet awe-inspiring presence.

additionalAbilities.name: Charging Lance
additionalAbilities.description: If the Charger moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward a target, it may use its lance to attack every creature whose space it passes through. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8+4 piercing damage. The attack ends when the Charger hits its primary target or fails to move into an unoccupied square.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Snare (1/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: The Charger can throw its lance up to 30 ft. at a point it can see. Upon impact, the lance bursts into writhing black tendrils, creating a 10 ft. radius area of difficult terrain. Any creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained. Restrained creatures may attempt the save again at the end of each of their turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Charger makes two melee attacks, either two Lance Strikes or one Lance Strike and one Hoof Stomp.

actions.name: Lance Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Hoof Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10+3 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tendril Arrow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) saving throw or be grappled by tendrils (10 HP, AC 8).

reactions.name: Back Kick
reactions.description: When an enemy passes through any threatened square within reach of the Charger Omega, it may make one hoof stomp strike.

flavor.description: A small, skeletal abomination support creature, its form composed of formless black and smoky miasmic condensate. This eerie being channels divine energy to aid its ossuite and ossokin allies. Its uncanny, bone-like structure belies its cleric abilities, and it wields a handful of divine spells – including the cantrip Spontaneous Accident – to bolster its kin in battle.

additionalAbilities.name: Divine Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description:
The creature is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:
• Cantrips (Spontaneous Accident, Guidance)
• 1st level (Bless, Cure Wounds)
• 2nd level (Lesser Restoration, Aid)
These divine spells and cleric abilities are focused on supporting and bolstering its ossuite and ossokin allies.

additionalAbilities.name: Ossuaries' Boon
additionalAbilities.description: Once per short rest, when an allied ossuite or ossokin is within 5 ft., the proselyte can grant that ally a bonus to saving throws equal to its Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) until the start of the ally's next turn.

actions.name: Bone Tap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4+1 bludgeoning damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactician
additionalAbilities.description: When in groups of more than 2, darklings will attempt to gang up on singular opponents and close distances with long ranged attackers. This Darkling, with its superior intellect, is capable of using its reaction to wordlessly give telepathic orders to any Darkling, Darkforme Overwatch, or Darkforme Enforcer it can see within 100 ft. If the darkling follows this command, they receive a +1 bonus to the action.

additionalAbilities.name: Degenerate Regenerator
additionalAbilities.description: If unwounded for 1 round, the Darkforme will begin to coalesce its being back together. Every round after the first round it is not wounded, the Darkforme Enforcer can restore 1d8 hitpoints at the end of its turn provided it does not move more than 10 ft in that turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Darkform Enforcer makes three attacks: two with its tendrils and one with its Pound attack.

actions.name: Tendril Barrage
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Slashing): +8 to hit, reach 15 ft, up to 3 targets. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6).

actions.name: Pound
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Blunt): +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Blistering Beam
actions.description: Energy Weapon Attack (Piercing): +7 to hit, range 100 ft (300 ft on long range), one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4).

flavor.description: Small abomination, a whimsical cactus creature that unexpectedly calls for help with its backup spines.

additionalAbilities.name: Grab Backup
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Darkling-Cactine may attempt to disengage. Roll 1d2; on a roll of 2 it calls reinforcements that rejoin the fray 1d2 rounds later in adjacent squares.

actions.name: Prickly Jab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+2 piercing damage.

flavor.description: Large centauroid abomination darkling with four-legged speed and a bow that fires arrow-tipped tendrils. Those struck must succeed on a saving throw or be grappled by the sticky tendrils, which attach with 10 HP and an AC of 8.

additionalAbilities.name: Arrow-Tipped Tendrils
additionalAbilities.description: When the Charger fires its bow, each target hit must succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) saving throw or be grappled. Tendrils attached function as objects with 10 HP and an AC of 8.

actions.name: Tendril Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage. On a hit, the target must make a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) saving throw or be grappled.

flavor.description: Medium abomination, a bristling cactus menace with brutal spike attacks and a lethal grappling maneuver called Heel ¡Lucha!

additionalAbilities.name: Heel ¡Lucha!
additionalAbilities.description: When the Darkforme-Spinebearer successfully grapples a creature, it may use a bonus action to initiate Heel ¡Lucha! The target takes an extra 2d6 piercing damage and becomes restrained until it escapes. The grappled creature may attempt to break free by making a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 14) as an action.

actions.name: Spike Jab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage.

actions.name: Spine Barrage
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10+1 piercing damage.

flavor.description: Medium bone golem abomination with a large build. Its fearsome, unliving bulk forms an unyielding defensive bulwark on the battlefield.

additionalAbilities.name: Bony Bulwark
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of its turn, the Darkling-Ossuite Aegisite gains temporary hit points equal to its proficiency bonus. Additionally, one adjacent ally gains a +2 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Bone Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+2 bludgeoning damage.

flavor.description: Small abomination, a chunkier, delightfully round cactus creature whose smooth exterior hides microcrystalline spines. Quick-footed and mischievous, it combines the call for backup of its kin with a painful, restraining embrace.

additionalAbilities.name: Relentless Backup
additionalAbilities.description: At the end of its turn, the Darkling-Cactine-Biggo-Boy automatically calls for reinforcements. Reinforcements arrive in 1d2 rounds. When backup arrives, roll a d100: on a result of 75 or lower, the reinforcement is a plain Darkling-Cactine; on a result of 76 or higher, a fellow Biggo-Boy joins the fray. Reinforcements appear in adjacent squares.

additionalAbilities.name: Painful Embrace
additionalAbilities.description: When the Darkling-Cactine-Biggo-Boy successfully grapples a creature, it may use a bonus action to execute a painful embrace. The target takes an additional 1d6 piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spiny Jab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+1 piercing damage.

flavor.description: Medium abomination, a grotesque creature with elongated, enveloping limbs that suffocate its prey with a crushing grip.

additionalAbilities.name: Suffocating Embrace
additionalAbilities.description: When the Darkeforme-Suffocator grapples a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check at the start of its turn or take 1d8 crushing damage as it struggles for air.

actions.name: Crushing Grip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+2 bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

flavor.description: Tiny abomination, a small little bone guy with an annoying shin-smacking attack that falls apart when defeated. Occasionally, its scattered bones reassemble—if not consecrated—minutes later.

additionalAbilities.name: Bone Reassembly
additionalAbilities.description: When defeated, the Darkling-Ossokin shatters into scattered bones. At 10 seconds and again 24 hours later, roll a d100; on a result of 10 or lower (for each window), if its remains haven't been consecrated, the bones reassemble into a functioning creature.

actions.name: Shin Smack
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

flavor.description: Large abomination, a majestic aerial predator rumored to have inspired umbral raven forms. With perfect flight and lethal swoop-and-dive tactics, it dominates the heavens.

additionalAbilities.name: Aerial Ace
additionalAbilities.description: When targeting a creature that is flying, the Sky-Darkener Nightveil gains a +3 supernatural bonus to its attack roll on one attack per round.

additionalAbilities.name: Swoop and Dive
additionalAbilities.description: As an action, the Sky-Darkener Nightveil can dive from the sky to make a melee attack. If the target is unprepared, it is knocked prone. This attack deals an extra 1d8 slashing damage.

actions.name: Taloned Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 slashing damage.

flavor.description: Small abomination, a sinuous reptilian darkling whose shimmering scales ripple as it slithers silently.

additionalAbilities.name: Slithering Escape
additionalAbilities.description: Once per turn, the Darkling-Slitherscale can disengage without provoking opportunity attacks, dodging away with slick, sinuous movements.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4+2 piercing damage.

flavor.description: Medium abomination, a larger and aggressive hooter whose piercing, debilitating peck leaves foes breathless—and reactionless.

actions.name: Debilitating Peck
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+2 piercing damage. The target is overwhelmed by a brown note effect and loses its reaction until the end of its next turn.

flavor.description: Huge abomination, a colossal serpentine dark serpent whose abyssal form can crush, devour, and lunge forth from the shadows with terrifying reach.

additionalAbilities.name: Serpent-Lance Lunge
additionalAbilities.description: If the Darkaconda has not moved on its previous turn, it may spend that turn coiling. During the coiling turn it can still make head or tail attacks; on the following turn, it can extend up to 60 ft. in any direction and make one attack using any of its available actions. This ability recharges on a 5–6 roll at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Swallow
additionalAbilities.description: When the Darkaconda grapples a creature, it can attempt to swallow it. A swallowed creature takes 2d8 piercing damage at the start of each of the Darkaconda’s turns and is restrained. The creature can attempt to escape by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.

actions.name: Shadow Lunge
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Crushing Coil
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 bludgeoning damage.

flavor.description: Tiny abomination, a cute yet annoying hooter whose gutwrenching call shakes nerves.

additionalAbilities.name: Gutwrenching Hootery
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, this Darkling-Hooter emits an ear-piercing hoot. Any creature within 25 ft. must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw—with the DC increasing by +5 for every additional Darkling-Hooter hooting that round—or lose its reaction until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Peck
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 piercing damage.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the grief-stone remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal section of worked stone wall, floor, or ceiling.

additionalAbilities.name: Emotional Predator
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the grief-stone and is frightened or has taken psychic damage must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have its speed halved until the start of its next turn. The grief-stone heals for half of any psychic damage it deals.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grief-stone makes two Grasping Wall attacks.

actions.name: Grasping Wall
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The grief-stone can have up to two targets grappled at a time.

actions.name: Whispers of Sorrow (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The grief-stone emits a wave of psychic despair in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage and be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Seal the Way (1/Day)
actions.description: The grief-stone chooses a doorway, archway, or other opening up to 10 feet wide within 60 feet. The opening is magically sealed with solid stone for 1 hour (dispel magic DC 15). The stone (AC 17, 30 HP) is immune to poison and psychic damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadowmist Jaunt
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the hall monitor can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. A 5-foot-radius cloud of magical darkness fills the space it left until the start of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Keen Senses
additionalAbilities.description: The hall monitor has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or hearing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hall monitor makes two attacks with its Gloom Rod.

actions.name: Gloom Rod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hey, Stop!! (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hall monitor targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of Order
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the Professor must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to use the Dash or Disengage action until the start of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Lesson in Pain
additionalAbilities.description: When a creature within 5 feet hits the Professor with a melee attack, the Professor can use its reaction to make a Rod of Correction attack against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Professor makes two attacks with its Rod of Correction.

actions.name: Rod of Correction
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spank! (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a miss, the target still takes half damage and is not stunned.

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: The Professor is an 8th-level spellcaster. Spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks. Cantrips (at will): Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Ray of Frost; 1st (4 slots): Command, Magic Missile, Shield; 2nd (3): Hold Person, Suggestion; 3rd (3): Counterspell, Fear; 4th (2): Banishment.

additionalAbilities.name: Strict Scrutiny
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Professor targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The Professor has advantage on its next spell attack roll against that creature before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Punishing Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spank! (Spell, Cantrip)
actions.description: A bolt of disciplinary energy at one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 1 force damage and be paralyzed until the end of their next turn (halved movement on a successful save). The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success (retaining halved movement until then).

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Dean can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options listed.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Dean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Inescapable Pursuit
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Dean teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Opportunity attacks made against it have disadvantage.

additionalAbilities.name: Terrifying Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Each creature of the Dean's choice within 30 feet and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success (immune for 24 hours on a success).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Dean makes three attacks: two with its Punitive Strike and one with its Grasping Shadow.

actions.name: Punitive Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Grasping Shadow
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled by shadowy tendrils (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Dean can't use Grasping Shadow on another target.

actions.name: Dean's Decree (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot radius must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned. A stunned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.description: The Dean uses its Inescapable Pursuit.

legendaryActions.name: Strike
legendaryActions.description: The Dean makes one Punitive Strike attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Cantrip (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Dean casts a cantrip (spell save DC 16).

additionalAbilities.name: Breaching Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Infiltrator has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Infiltrator's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Infiltrator makes two attacks with its Arc-Saber.

actions.name: Arc-Saber
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

actions.name: Magitech Scattergun (Recharge 4–6)
actions.description: The Infiltrator fires its weapon in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Magitech Savant
additionalAbilities.description: The Void Scholar has advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to analyze, disable, or operate magitech devices.

additionalAbilities.name: Phase Step (Recharge 5–6)
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Void Scholar magically teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Void Scholar makes two attacks: any combination of Vibro-Dagger and Force Bolt.

actions.name: Vibro-Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Force Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) force damage.

actions.name: Null Pulse (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Void Scholar emits destabilizing energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Aggressive
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Vanguard can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

additionalAbilities.name: Shield Guard
additionalAbilities.description: When a creature the Vanguard can see attacks a target other than the Vanguard within 5 feet of it, the Vanguard can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Vanguard makes two attacks with its Kinetic Maul.

actions.name: Kinetic Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The first time the Vanguard hits a creature on its turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of the Vanguard's next turn.

actions.name: Magitech Handcannon
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Justicar can take 2 legendary actions per round.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of Determination
additionalAbilities.description: Any ally within 10 feet of the Justicar has advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

additionalAbilities.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: The Justicar can reroll a saving throw that it fails. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Justicar makes three attacks with its Executioner's Axe.

actions.name: Executioner's Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage.

actions.name: Condemn (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Justicar chooses one creature it can see within 30 feet. For the next minute, all attacks made against the target by the Justicar and its allies score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Justicar makes one Executioner's Axe attack.

legendaryActions.name: Reposition
legendaryActions.description: The Justicar moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Rallying Cry (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each ally within 30 feet that can hear the Justicar gains 10 temporary hit points.

additionalAbilities.name: Fusion
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, fuses with another slime-like darkling within 5 feet. The target darkling gains 2d6 hit points; the Tiny Slime Darkling is consumed.

additionalAbilities.name: Harmless Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Tiny Slime Darklings are incapable of causing harm or dealing damage. Their sole purpose is aiding larger slimes through fusion and healing.

additionalAbilities.name: Consume Tiny Slime
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, absorbs a Tiny Slime Darkling within 5 feet, healing for 2d6 hit points.

additionalAbilities.name: Split
additionalAbilities.description: When reduced to 0 hit points, splits into two Tiny Slime Darklings instead of dying.

actions.name: Pseudopod Strike
